question: residue 2026-09-06-t-stuck-validated-on-ring-only: writers.RUN_MIN_BY_STREAM applies T_STUCK=200 SAMPLES to five streams; the plateau distribution behind it was measured on O2Ring 8-bit pleth only. Its closing condition is 'the same query as the ring's, per stream' - and the ring's figures are a LADDER (p50 1 / p90 4 / p99 14 / p99.9 31 / p99.99 48), not a single quantile.
criterion: PRE-REGISTERED before any stream was read. Over non-sentinel run lengths: P=p99.99, N=#{runs>=200}, [a,b]=widest MULTIPLICATIVE gap above P taken between CONSECUTIVE OBSERVED lengths (bracketed by construction). UNDERPOWERED <1e6 samples; no gap (b/a<4): NOT-EXERCISED if N=0 else NO GAP; gap: FAIL-LOW if 200<a, FAIL-HIGH if 200>b (tested BEFORE N), else HOLD. Factor 4 inherited from the shipped constant, not invented.
answer: NOT-EXERCISED on all four streams. Zero runs reach 200 samples in ~550M samples per stream, so this corpus cannot validate 200 in either direction on any stream it was silently extended to.

asymmetry.falsePositives: excluded by 1-2 orders of magnitude on every stream: 200/p99.99 = 100x (verity-ppg) 33x (verity-acc) 12x (h10-acc) 100x (ppg2w) against the 4.17x the constant was designed at on the ring. 200 will never flag real signal there.
asymmetry.falseNegatives: UNTESTABLE from this corpus: a stream with no stuck spans cannot show what a stuck span looks like. The first must not be read as reassurance about the second.

ppg2wNearMiss: ppg2w read HOLD on all-runs with N=1 - a single run, belonging to the most run-producing value. Top-1-value excluded: N=0, NOT-EXERCISED. The gap moves across the cut between the two reports. Without the modal-excluded report pre-registered, a HOLD resting on one run indistinguishable from a sentinel would have entered the row as 'the constant transfers'.
corroboration: The shipped detector's own sidecars agree from the other side: of 68 flagged 'stuck' spans in the corpus, 66 are O2Ring PPGRUNS and 2 O2Ring PPG2WRUNS - ZERO Verity, ZERO H10 (flagged values 100 x62, 99 x4, 0 x2, all ring pleth). Two instruments, one conclusion, no shared blind spot.
correction: An earlier statement of mine pooled all *RUNS* sidecars without splitting by device and implied those flagged spans belonged to the streams under test. They did not. Found by chasing the apparent contradiction against this run's N=0 rather than explaining it away. The censoring point it supported (min=200 exactly = the threshold) is unaffected.
rates: MEASURED from the corpus, not the declared table: verity-ppg 55.13 Hz, verity-acc/h10-acc 51.68 Hz, ppg2w 127.76 Hz, ring ppg1 ~127.76 Hz. So 200 samples is 1.57 s where it was derived, 3.63 s on Verity PPG, 3.87 s on ACC. The 200>=4*p99.99 test is unit-invariant within a stream; the rate matters for what the threshold MEANS.

ladderComparison.reading: The RING's legitimate plateaus are 3.5-14x longer at p99 than any other stream's. That is the 8-bit quantisation: a coarse ADC holds one code across many samples, while the Verity's fine-grained values almost never repeat. A constant derived from the coarsest stream is therefore FAR above the plateau scale of every finer one - which is why 200 sits at 12-100x p99.99 elsewhere against the 4.17x it was designed at.
